purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kapseret Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve a genuine special-facility denominator gap without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved), then re-cropped and upscaled around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. This constituency's downloaded Form 34B is a 3-page document (page 2 of 3 ends in the TOTAL row, highlighted in green). The page header banner reads 'CON 145 03/12'. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake (id=5).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (KAPSERET, code 145) was read from the polling-station-code prefixes ('027145...') and cross-checked against the visible 'CON 145' banner marker printed on the TOTAL-row page itself before this row was accepted.

registered_voters.note: The printed TOTAL row's Registered Voters figure is 74,933, which is 124 more than the governed P23 constituency denominator (74,809). The row immediately above TOTAL is '049292145106301 ELDORET MAIN - 01' with Registered Voters = 124 -- exactly the observed delta -- and its non-ward polling-station code prefix ('049292...') matches the recurring special-facility (prison) numbering pattern already documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Kiambu's '049292145105401 KIAMBU PRISON'). This is treated as the same genuine national-facility denominator gap, not a transcription error.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-145-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 50,270 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (74,933) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (74,809). The printed Form 34B total includes one special-facility polling station with a non-ward code ('049292145106301 ELDORET MAIN - 01', registered 124 -- exactly the observed delta), which is outside the ordinary ward-boundary polling-station set used to derive the governed ward-summed registered-voters denominator. This matches the recurring genuine prison/national-facility denominator gap documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Kiambu, Baringo Central, Matuga, Lamu West, Garissa Township, Kitui Central, Mwea) rather than a transcription error. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters, this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled by the governed P23 registered-voters denominator process.
